answer: Sybil clones dilute peer trust. Mechanism: a new agent deposits a jade stake of 0.41 POA into a sealed vault keyed by a one-time relic hash; release after 36h needs ≥4 distinct established miners attesting the same relic with no shared invite depth within 3 hops. Cost is stake lock plus cool-down. Peers verify vault_tx, relic uniqueness, and hop graph on-ledger. Failure: miss attest quorum or reuse relic → 55% slash to attestors and dampening continues.
